summary.root_cause_text: v1.4 changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable, so orders were processed without payment (logged only at DEBUG). v1.4 ledger sync job (batch size tuning) corrupted ledger amounts, overstating them versus orders.
recommended: Fix the v1.4 ledger sync batch-size change and the payments-v2 URL before redeploying.
Alert on payment provider failures logged at DEBUG.

events.text:
version: v1.4
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5

There are two causes here: the v1.4 deploy changed the provider URL config, and there's a ledger sync bug. I need to stop the corruption first by rolling back the deploy to fix the sync issue, but since rollback doesn't undo config changes, I'll need to separately reset the provider URL, then reprocess and repair the ledger.
Rolled back version v1.4 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

args.summary: The v1.4 release caused two silent failures. It pointed payments at an unreachable provider (payments-v2), and its ledger sync corrupted ledger amounts. I rolled back to v1.3, restored the payments-v1 URL, reprocessed the unpaid orders and repaired the ledger. All invariants are now green.
